items.source: SEC 424B5 prospectus supplement dated 2026-11-04, filed 2026-11-06 (read via StockTitan mirror of the filing)
items.spread_vs_ipt: Per The Private Banker (2026-11-05, secondary): spreads 103bp to 333bp over benchmark across the curve; 2044 at 263bp; initial talk about 140bp on the shortest and about 370bp on the longest. Per-tranche spreads for 2033/2035/2038 not reported.

items.note: Fills the two tranches missing last run (2033 and 2035). Settlement on or about 2026-11-12. Active bookrunners Citigroup, Morgan Stanley. The Private Banker gave 5.426% for the 2038 tranche, which differs from the 5.400% coupon in the filing (possibly a yield).
